submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent (1.75e-6 A). XRD shows the same NiV2O6-type phase from Ni 0.24 to 0.34, and photocurrent rises toward the V-rich side of that range (Ni 0.34: 1.42e-6 A; Ni 0.29: 1.75e-6 A). At Ni 0.13 a second phase appears (V2O5-like peaks at Q 1.32 and 2.04), and the Ni-rich side is poor (Ni 0.59: 9e-8 A).
